name: @emsenn/claude-code-cli-harness-topology
description: The Claude Code CLI harness as a meme-topology carrier — the diamond floor, downstream of both agent-harness-topology (it equips an agent with channels) and claude-code-topology (it embodies an agent running a claude model). Its CLI slots are mcp-server, skill, command, subagent, hook, and setting; the load-bearing edge is mcp-server --points-at--> the hub (AGRODAO), so every tool/read routes You<->MCP<->AGRODAO.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node ../../scripts/package-boundary/copy-dmts-to-dts.mjs dist
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".tmp/test-dist/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test
